name: Segment-Box Collision Detection with Radius
definition: Determines if a line segment from point a to point b intersects a box defined by lower corner lo and upper corner hi, considering a spherical radius around the segment.
summary: Segment-Box Collision Detection with Radius determines if a thickened segment intersects an axis-aligned box, distinguishing itself from standard ray-box intersection by treating the segment as a capsule rather than an infinitely thin line.
